task.title: Lease and authenticate the Deployment saga dispatcher

actual_state: outbox retry, DLQ, replay, and compensation receipts

scope.owned_layer: Deployment and promotion authentication/tenant boundary plus Deployment outbox dispatcher ownership and recovery
scope.authoritative_write_owner: Deployment owns plans, sagas, outbox/inbox, and lease receipts; Runtime Manager remains sole RuntimeBinding writer
composes_with: existing L1 DeploymentSaga outbox/inbox and RuntimeBinding contracts

proof: Missing bearer identity, an unauthorized role, and a missing tenant are rejected.
Authenticated actor identity replaces a forged created_by value.
Cross-tenant DeploymentPlan and promotion ApprovalDecision reads are hidden.
Two concurrent store instances race on one event and exactly one receives a claim.
The durable health ledger reports exactly one active claim.
Lease expiry increments recovery_count and rejects the former owner's stale acknowledgement.
A successful empty poll restores degraded worker health and records last_idle_success plus last_recovered_at.
The first dispatch creates and authoritatively reads one RuntimeBinding.
After simulated process loss and lease recovery, saga binding_id drives the idempotent GET path and RuntimeManagerClient.deploy remains called once.
The service and worker suites expose retry scheduling, dead-letter state, governed replay, compensation sequencing, and kill-switch-first containment.
Terminal and replay paths re-read current RuntimeBinding and DEP-003 projection state before acknowledging outbox delivery.
DeploymentPlan tenant is copied to DeploymentSaga metadata.
The worker copies authenticated tenant and foundation correlation id to RuntimeBinding dispatch metadata.

rbac.proof: Deployment and promotion protected routes require an accepted authenticated role.

tenant_isolation.proof: Persisted plan, saga, outbox/inbox, approval, and promotion plan ownership is filtered or rejected at the authenticated tenant boundary.

no_live_capital.proof: This task changes dispatcher ownership and evidence only; it does not enable live-capital authority.

kill_switch_priority.proof: Existing worker acceptance keeps kill/safe-mode containment ahead of rollback compensation.

two_person_approval.proof: Owner Codex2 and reviewer Codex are distinct.

acceptance.statement: Deployment mutations authenticate authoritative actor and tenant.
Two consumers cannot concurrently own the same outbox event.
Crash after RuntimeBinding side effect and before acknowledgement does not duplicate the binding.
Retry, DLQ, replay, compensation, and idle health recovery are visible.
Approval, plan, saga, binding, and runtime stages retain shared correlation and current downstream terminal readback.

manifest_activation_pending.description: Compose and dev environment must inject the dispatcher service token, tenant, and selected auth mode before activation.
manifest_activation_pending.containment: The worker fails closed when token or tenant is missing.

file_lease_topology.description: The reconciled file-backed baseline assumes all dispatcher replicas share one POSIX lease path.
file_lease_topology.containment: fcntl serialization and atomic replace prevent concurrent ownership on the shared path; a future distributed store must preserve compare-and-set semantics.
